verdict_summary: Deep2 Layer 0 GPU inference cannot be certified. Three independent blockers, each with evidence below.

requested_gates.LAYER0_GPU_WEIGHTS_RESIDENT: NOT TESTED - no GPU inference path exists
requested_gates.REAL_GPU_DISPATCH_COUNT_GT_0: PASS for the standalone matmul kernel only
requested_gates.ROPE_NUMERIC_PARITY: FAIL - ExecuteRoPE is a no-op placeholder
requested_gates.ATTENTION_NUMERIC_PARITY: FAIL - ExecuteAttention is a CPU implementation
requested_gates.UNEXPECTED_STUB_EXECUTION: FAIL - a stub header is actively used

blocker_1_deep2_has_no_gpu_path.finding: ModelGenieExecutor.cpp and ModelGenieExecutor.hpp contain zero references to Vulkan.
blocker_1_deep2_has_no_gpu_path.evidence: Grep for /Vulkan|vulkan/ across both files returns no matches.
blocker_1_deep2_has_no_gpu_path.consequence: There is no GPU execution path in the Deep2 inference engine to certify. All LinearFwd, AttentionFwd, RMSNorm, RoPE and MoE primitives execute on the CPU.

blocker_2_stub_header_shadows_real_vulka.finding: include/vulkan/vulkan.h is a minimal stub that shadows the real Vulkan SDK header.
blocker_2_stub_header_shadows_real_vulka.evidence: File header comment: "Minimal Vulkan stub for compilation without Vulkan SDK - Defines only the types used by vulkan_compute.h". It forward-declares opaque handles but provides no Vk*CreateInfo structs and no vk* entry points.
blocker_2_stub_header_shadows_real_vulka.consequence: src/vulkan_compute.cpp (66 KB, 8 real vkCmdDispatch/vkQueueSubmit/vkWaitForFences calls) does NOT compile against the real Vulkan API in the main tree. Every build configuration that puts include/ before the SDK silently gets the stub. This is why the GPU path never materialised.
blocker_2_stub_header_shadows_real_vulka.workaround_used_in_test: The test harness orders the SDK Include directory first. That is a harness-only change; the repository build was not modified.

blocker_3_existing_kernel_is_numerically.finding: When src/vulkan_compute.cpp IS compiled against the real Vulkan API, the one genuine GPU kernel produces incorrect results.

defect_localization.method: Compared the GPU output against five layout hypotheses.
defect_localization.conclusion: The defect is NOT a simple transpose or layout mismatch. The GPU output has approximately the correct magnitude (sum(Cpu)=-0.8924 vs sum(Gpu)=-0.3995) but wrong values, which points at incorrect tile/workgroup-to-matrix mapping or incorrect K accumulation bounds inside the shader or its push-constant contract.

blocker_3_existing_kernel_is_numerically.deterministic_repeat: PASS - a second dispatch reproduced the same (wrong) result bitwise.

what_was_genuinely_established.note: The R9700 is genuinely usable through the existing Vulkan wrapper. The infrastructure works; the arithmetic does not.

prerequisite_work_to_unblock: Remove or rename include/vulkan/vulkan.h so the real Vulkan SDK header is used, and verify src/vulkan_compute.cpp compiles against the real API in the main build.
Fix the matmul kernel so GPU matches CPU within a declared per-tensor tolerance. Localize by validating the shader push-constant contract against the dispatch call (M, K, N and tile sizes).
Implement real GPU RoPE. VulkanCompute::ExecuteRoPE is a documented placeholder that performs no work.
Implement a GPU execution path inside ModelGenieExecutor, or prove the existing wrapper can drive Deep2 Layer 0, before any Deep2 Layer 0 GPU parity gate is meaningful.

reproduction.note: The build script deliberately places the Vulkan SDK Include before the repository include directory so the real API is used rather than the stub.
reproduction.dependencies: None. Uses the installed Vulkan SDK 1.4.357.0 loader and the existing src/vulkan_compute.cpp.

scope_discipline: No GPU success is claimed. The only PASS results above concern the matmul kernel dispatch mechanics, not Deep2 correctness. Deep2 Layer 0 GPU parity remains entirely unverified.
